group_manifest.proof_strategy: For each theorem choose the generated pure/emp disjunct. Unfold CircularAreaDescriptorState; rewrite unsigned_last_nbits readidx 32 and then unsigned_last_nbits (readidx + data_length) 32 using unsigned_last_nbits_eq with bounds from the descriptor, data_length nonnegativity, and the UINT_MAX sum bound. Unfold CircularAreaDivideRdDataResult, select the wrap disjunct for return 1 or non-wrap disjunct for return 0, discharge arithmetic from the normalized guard, and close the unchanged emp frame.

group_entry.proof_strategy: For each theorem choose the generated pure/emp disjunct. Unfold CircularAreaDescriptorState; rewrite unsigned_last_nbits readidx 32 and then unsigned_last_nbits (readidx + data_length) 32 using unsigned_last_nbits_eq with bounds from the descriptor, data_length nonnegativity, and the UINT_MAX sum bound. Unfold CircularAreaDivideRdDataResult, select the wrap disjunct for return 1 or non-wrap disjunct for return 0, discharge arithmetic from the normalized guard, and close the unchanged emp frame.
group_entry.natural_language_proof_strategy: Normalize the machine-integer guard to its mathematical sum and use the same guard to establish the exact result relation; no state resource is modified.

vc_shape.kind: generated Coq disjunction between a full unchanged-frame entailment and a pure TT/emp entailment
vc_shape.common_pre_pure: descriptor bounds, data_length bounds, UINT_MAX sum bound, and one branch guard
vc_shape.common_post_pure: CircularAreaDivideRdDataResult for the concrete return value
vc_shape.common_spatial: unchanged descriptor and full byte buffer

witness_instantiation.proof_of_CircularAreaDivideRdData_return: choose the wrapping disjunct of CircularAreaDivideRdDataResult with ret = 1
choose the non-wrapping disjunct of CircularAreaDivideRdDataResult with ret = 0

space_plan.shared: choose the pure theorem disjunct and close TT/emp after proving the pure proposition; the full spatial alternative also has an exact cancellable frame

pure_plan.shared: unfold descriptor invariant; prove both 32-bit projections are identities; rewrite the guard; unfold the result relation; choose the corresponding disjunct

premise_discharge.unsigned_sum_bound: from readidx >= 0, data_length >= 0, and readidx + data_length <= 4294967295
premise_discharge.result_inequality: from the branch guard after both unsigned rewrites
